atoms.text:
Humans keep inventing new technology in order to make travelling faster and safer.

Select the aeroplane to learn more about different modes of transportation.
atoms.sound: ssml: Humans keep inventing new technology in order to make travelling faster and safer. Select the aeroplane to learn more about different modes of transportation.

hint.text: A timeline is a line that shows the order of certain events in time. They can help you show information in an understandable and easy way.

atoms.text:
First, humans used their legs to walk and get around. Walking is good for your health, but it also takes a long time to get from one place to the other.

Select the word timeline to see what happened next.
atoms.sound: First, humans used their legs to walk and get around. Walking is good for your health, but it also takes a long time to get from one place to the other. Select the word timeline to see what happened next.

atoms.text:
Eventually, humans started to tame horses as a means of travel. This made travelling a lot faster.

Select the horse to see what happened next.
atoms.sound: ssml: Eventually, humans started to tame horses as a means of travel. This made travelling a lot faster. Select the horse to see what happened next.

atoms.text:
The year 1825 marks an important year in British travel history. In this year, the first railroad was introduced from Stockton to Darlington.

Select the train to see what happened next.
atoms.sound: ssml: The year 1825 marks an important year in British travel history. In this year, the first railroad was introduced from Stockton to Darlington. Select the train to see what happened next.

atoms.text:
In the early 20th century, cars largely replaced horses and carriages making personal travel even faster.

Select the car to learn more.
atoms.sound: ssml:In the early 20th century, cars largely replaced horses and carriages, making personal travel even faster. Select the car to learn more.

atoms.text: Today, aeroplanes are the fastest mode of transportation. Some of the fastest aeroplanes can fly up to 634 mph. Now, travelling from the UK to distant countries only takes a few hours, rather than days or weeks.
atoms.sound: ssml: Today, aeroplanes are the fastest mode of transportation. Some of the fastest aeroplanes can fly up to 634mph. Now, travelling from the UK to distant countries only takes a few hours, rather than days or weeks.

instruction.text: Which mode of transportation has not been mentioned yet. Select the correct picture.

end.text: Boats have been used for hundreds of years to travel across oceans, lakes or rivers. Some are powered by an engine while others sail with the wind.
